notes.title: Skins With Style! Unique Music and Enemies!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/f7810b55757534960389ffc7d5fb02205c032098.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s time to take your style to the next level! This update makes your high-tier skins (bottom row) more than just cosmetic… now they come with their own [b]custom remix of the main theme[/b] plus unique environmental twists that change how the game looks![/p][p][/p][p]🆕 [b]Skin Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Jack-o-Lantern[/b] - Darkened lighting, thunder & lightning effects, & bats swooping in instead of rats[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pirate[/b] - Parrots replace rats, zombies show up dressed like scurvy sea pirates[/p][/*][*][p][b]Robo[/b] - Android zombies with explosive deaths for extra chaos[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chicken[/b] - Pissed off chickens swarm the room instead of rats[/p][/*][*][p][b]Golden[/b] - Golden zombies that drop gold coins at a higher rate[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/c9900391b399297b8e525db444b66d555e53926c.png"][/img][/p][p]🎨 [b]Menus to Match:[/b]
Each skin now changes the [b]main menu background[/b] to match its theme[/p][p][/p][p]🎵 [b]Music Options:[/b]
Don’t forget, you can disable or lower the music in the Options menu if you prefer the pure sound of mayhem.[/p][p][/p][p]🪳 [b]Other Patch Notes Update 0.2.0.0:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor optimizations to improve performance with new skin effects[/p][/*][*][p]You can now exchange all of your bones at once to cash in more gold quickly![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/27dcfcb9ad064a6d82b1f8ca48db7223de8c2ac1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/8a9e2d79b46c8f0ac5df39259aae376ed242c53f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/b81e01e1ce470015b801f74cc1552a07efbe8c91.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/29cff4d5eb5572a4d9e1897921ac157dced35e3b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Weapon Upgrades Now Available!!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/068af1953607c1c14bae9260c587c0f92883ca8d.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s time to power up your arsenal and push your high scores to the limit! This update adds [b]upgrade paths for every weapon[/b] in the game.... and each one can be upgraded [b]three times[/b] for maximum destruction.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🆕 Weapon Upgrade Details:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Pistol[/b] - Increases [b]firing speed[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shotgun[/b] - Increases [b]range[/b] and [b]damage[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Assault Rifle[/b] - Increases [b]ammo capacity[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Flamethrower[/b] - Increases [b]fuel tank size[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Space Gun[/b] - Increases [b]plasma cell capacity[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/f469fef0dc3ab7d17abbadcb0cc2d724be6d8851.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]💰 How to Unlock:[/b][/h3][p]Each upgrade costs [b]25 gold[/b], via the "Upgrades" menu. Upgrade them all to unlock the full potential of your weapons and take on the ultimate challenge... breaking your high scores![/p][p][/p][h3]🪳 [b]Other Patch Notes Update 0.1.2.0:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Shotgun in general has been improved (increased range, damage, close range hitbox)[/p][/*][*][p]Menu bug fixed with skin purchase order[/p][/*][*][p]miscellaneous bug fixes, please let us know of any you find! :)  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/8033d7b801669077a0a1073486a1c7b6cadb5931.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/a852fd17a40754ca8980f9689ea6eb8ba4098908.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update! 6/16/2025
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/f2cada63c445121ed1ca7bada63bf512bd791fbb.png"][/img]
Previously LootLocker was used for leaderbaords, which was not tied to anyone steam account and caused crashes when not loaded properly. Often usernames were rejected because of content filters. Now everything is tied to your steam account![/p][p][/p][p]Whats New?[/p][list][*][p]Steam Achievements - share your demo progress with your friends! [/p][/*][*][p]Steam Leaderboards - prove your skills to the world! [/p][/*][*][p]miscellaneous visual improvements and bug fixes during gameplay [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Looking forward to seeing your scores! [/p]

notes.title: ⚡New Level Unlocked: BLACKOUT!⚡
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/ff629bbde68346756c0e4a0284249b59b9fbbf97.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Lights out. Guns up![/b][/h1][p] The power’s dead, the lab’s in ruins, and Professor Rotstein’s back from the grave...armed with a twisted mind and a high-voltage death machine! As electrified undead swarm the lab, you’ll finally get your hands on weapons... but you’ll need every shot to survive this blackout nightmare![/p][h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1][list][*][p] He’s wired.[/p][/*][*][p]You’re outsmarted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Good thing you’re armed.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/577dae334e514cd771718b55f152f8cab1f70ff7.jpg"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/adf3d607f695c1852411d5b750cb679a9c271c70.jpg"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/30ab1973c259c0376c3360d4ee3018aa0113a884.jpg"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/20ecbad5e867cf87e88926a54f8ece6716a5834a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Welcome to the blackout. Let’s see if you can flip the switch before Professor Rotstein 's zombies fry you alive! [/b][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 New Level Unlocked: INFERNO 🔥
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/26ff6dee12d826cb23fc8270930c0e50b071e167.png"][/img]
Dodge waves of relentless zombies with zero weapons, all while volcanic boulders rain down like fiery death from above. You’ve got no guns, no nukes—just your power-ups and whatever instincts you’ve got left.

Features: 
[/p][list][*][p] They’re hungry. 
[/p][/*][*][p] You’re cornered.
[/p][/*][*][p] You won’t survive.[/p][/*][/list][p] [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/afc3522bf8655975a4bd190bb16dd4b8f9d69c2c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/76a98dc503c985194287885cccb3bbc01229e6ff.jpg"][/img][/url]  [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/fb3630115e703571c08f1a0bf71258979ee8b9ab.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/81d56eeaf7e25e5f09f8bcbed2beaefe67654d40.jpg"][/img][/url] [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/fa40cee023c7191b1f8a7e9233a50d895d871f52.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/6d7896db127b254f86550c69eef6655c35c7f6d5.jpg"][/img][/url] [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/ae36e3c418e7ca879ac876df2e5890b7e9bad6dc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/d8d47e11731ab30be376415f099c9382c0b7e96c.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p]Let’s see how long you can last!!
